import random
from faker import Faker
from demo_app import \(
    generate_clinical_patients, generate_clinical_encounters,
    generate_clinical_diagnoses, generate_clinical_labs,
    generate_student_records, generate_student_enrollment,
    generate_hr_employees, generate_iam_accounts, generate_iam_entitlements,
    generate_research_subjects, generate_research_studies,
    generate_financial_claims, to_csv_string, to_json_string, to_sql_string,
    validate_text
\)

random.seed\(42\)
Faker.seed\(42\)
fake = Faker\(\)

# Test each generator
tests = [
    \('Clinical Patients', generate_clinical_patients\(20, fake\)\),
    \('Encounters', generate_clinical_encounters\(20, fake\)\),
    \('Diagnoses', generate_clinical_diagnoses\(20, fake\)\),
    \('Labs', generate_clinical_labs\(20, fake\)\),
    \('Students', generate_student_records\(20, fake\)\),
    \('Enrollment', generate_student_enrollment\(20, fake\)\),
    \('HR Employees', generate_hr_employees\(20, fake\)\),
    \('IAM Accounts', generate_iam_accounts\(20, fake\)\),
    \('IAM Entitlements', generate_iam_entitlements\(20, fake\)\),
    \('Research Subjects', generate_research_subjects\(20, fake\)\),
    \('Research Studies', generate_research_studies\(20, fake\)\),
    \('Financial Claims', generate_financial_claims\(20, fake\)\),
]

for name, df in tests:
    print\(f'{name}: {len\(df\)} rows, {len\(df.columns\)} cols'\)

# Test formatters
df = tests[0][1]
csv_out = to_csv_string\(df\)
json_out = to_json_string\(df\)
sql_out = to_sql_string\(df, 'patients'\)

print\(f'\\nCSV output: {len\(csv_out\)} chars'\)
print\(f'JSON output: {len\(json_out\)} chars'\)
print\(f'SQL output: {len\(sql_out\)} chars'\)

# Test validator
results = validate_text\(csv_out\)
print\(f'\\nValidation: {len\(results[\\"critical\\"]\)} critical, {len\(results[\\"warnings\\"]\)} warnings, {len\(results[\\"info\\"]\)} info'\)
print\('All tests passed!'\)
")

Bash(python3 << 'PYEOF'
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

with sync_playwright\(\) as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch\(headless=True\)
    page = browser.new_page\(viewport={"width": 1400, "height": 900}\)
    
    page.goto\("http://localhost:8501", wait_until="networkidle"\)
    page.wait_for_timeout\(3000\)
    
    # Click Generate Data button
    page.click\("button:has-text\('Generate Data'\)"\)
    page.wait_for_timeout\(4000\)
    
    # Capture the preview tab
    page.screenshot\(path="/tmp/synth_demo_preview.png", full_page=True\)
    print\("Preview tab captured"\)
    
    # Click Validation tab
    page.click\("button:has-text\('Validation'\)"\)
    page.wait_for_timeout\(2000\)
    page.screenshot\(path="/tmp/synth_demo_validation.png", full_page=True\)
    print\("Validation tab captured"\)
    
    # Click Statistics tab
    page.click\("button:has-text\('Statistics'\)"\)
    page.wait_for_timeout\(2000\)
    page.screenshot\(path="/tmp/synth_demo_stats.png", full_page=True\)
    print\("Statistics tab captured"\)
    
    browser.close\(\)
print\("Done!"\)
PYEOF)
